<!-- Adding or updating a map? A line on what kind of fight it is, and this checklist. -->

- [ ] The file is `maps/<slug>.steel-tide-map`, exported from the game's Map Editor (or its *Publish* button brought me here)
- [ ] It has a name of its own and a description, and at least two spawn points
- [ ] `node tools/check.mjs maps/<slug>.steel-tide-map` passes (CI runs it too)
- [ ] I played it once, from the Conquest setup's *Upload map…*
- [ ] It is mine to publish under CC-BY-4.0
